note: Potomac-Garrett State Forest, dispersed campsites along Lostland Run road leading to north branch of Potomac River.  Self-registration kiosk on Lost Land Run road near Potomac Camp road.  --AWH  DNR, October 2026: 'Lostland Run Road is closed at Campsite 22 due to unsafe bridge conditions.' --Claude
summary: Confirmed on DNR's current Potomac-Garrett recreation page: 5 sites, first-come first-served, $10/night, 14-night maximum; added year-round season and vault toilets. Note: dropped the site count and price AWH's note repeats, added DNR's active closure of Lostland Run Road at Campsite 22. Not stated: road condition, rig length, water.
flags: Website: https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/PotomacGarrett/Camping.aspx is dead (404, redirects to DNR's page-not-found); DNR's current camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/PotomacGarrett/recreation-trails.aspx (forest home page https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/western_potomacgarrettforest.aspx).
